Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 飑线警报?

In this glossary, 飑线警报 refers to: Notification that organised line of squalls with gusts ≥ 34 kn is approaching, often ahead of cold front.

How is 飑线警报 used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "密西西比海峡VTS发布飑线警报；预计20分钟内阵风40节，请减速并守听一二频道。"

Why does 飑线警报 matter in maritime?

飑线警报 matters because it supports clear communication in Meteorology contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses 飑线警报?

飑线警报 is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does 飑线警报 belong to?

In this glossary, 飑线警报 is grouped under Meteorology. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

Notification that organised line of squalls with gusts ≥ 34 kn is approaching, often ahead of cold front.

Operational example

VTS Mississippi Sound issues squall line alert; gusts four-zero knots expected within twenty minutes, reduce speed and standby on channel one-two.

Localized term

飑线警报

Localized example

密西西比海峡VTS发布飑线警报；预计20分钟内阵风40节，请减速并守听一二频道。
